================================================================================
Word-concatenated substitution with a leading space
================================================================================

echo a` date`

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (command
    (command_name
      (word))
    (concatenation
      (word)
      (command_substitution
        (command
          (command_name
            (word)))))))

================================================================================
Assignment value with a leading-space substitution
================================================================================

v=a` b`

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (variable_assignment
    (variable_name)
    (concatenation
      (word)
      (command_substitution
        (command
          (command_name
            (word)))))))

================================================================================
Word-concatenated substitution across a newline
================================================================================

echo a`
b`

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (command
    (command_name
      (word))
    (concatenation
      (word)
      (command_substitution
        (command
          (command_name
            (word)))))))

================================================================================
Adjacent substitution without a leading space
================================================================================

echo a`date`b

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (command
    (command_name
      (word))
    (word)
    (concatenation
      (command_substitution
        (command
          (command_name
            (word))))
      (word))))
